page_title: GIR 4-2 BAR | Girona v Barcelona 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+4' A loose ball is pounced on by Yangel Herrera (Girona) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen is alert and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. Girona win a corner kick.
90+3' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Joao Felix (Barcelona) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
89' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
88' Raphinha (Barcelona) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
86' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:7.
86' A substitution has been made. Savio is replaced by Valery (Girona).
84' Substitution. Lamine Yamal makes his way off the pitch and Joao Felix (Barcelona) comes on as his replacement.
80' Barcelona are seeing far more of the ball now.
79' Xavi has decided to make a change. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) replaces Robert Lewandowski.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) will replace Sergi Roberto.
77' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends it out of play.
74' 4 - 2 Goal! Portu (Girona) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom left corner. It's 4:2.
74' Ivan Martin (Girona) is flagged for offside.
72' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

72' Yangel Herrera (Girona) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Marc-Andre ter Stegen anticipates the shot and makes a decent save. The referee signals a corner kick to Girona.
69' The attendance for today's match is 14090.
69' Xavi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raphinha (Barcelona) replacing Fermin Lopez.
69' Substitution. Pedri (Barcelona) replaces Andreas Christensen.
67' 3 - 2 Goal! Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Marc-Andre ter Stegen. He makes it 3:2.
65' 2 - 2 Goal! Artem Dovbyk plays a pass to the feet of Portu (Girona), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 2:2.
65' Michel prepares a substitution. David Lopez is replaced by Portu (Girona).
65' Viktor Tsygankov will be replaced by Yan Couto (Girona).
61' Aleix Garcia (Girona) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
61' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Good work from Girona as they win a corner.

59' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
56' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
55' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
53' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' A fine pass finds Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Paulo Gazzaniga reacts superbly to deny him.
49' Aleix Garcia (Girona) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
47' Ivan Martin (Girona) attempts to find Artem Dovbyk, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Paulo Gazzaniga to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
45+1' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is going to take the penalty!
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
44' Referee Alejandro Hernandez makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Barcelona. Let’s see what happens!
43' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
43' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Barcelona for a penalty. Play continues.
41' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
39' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

37' Ivan Martin (Girona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Hernandez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
35' Daley Blind (Girona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
33' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
31' Ivan Martin (Girona) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
29' Aleix Garcia (Girona) crosses the ball from the free kick, but his attempt is overhit and it goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
28' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Jules Kounde (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
26' Ivan Martin (Girona) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Viktor Tsygankov, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
24' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) commits a foul during an attacking move.
23' The ball is cleared after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' Savio (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' A quickly taken corner by Girona.

18' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
17' The ball possession is 30:70.

15' What a great chance for Andreas Christensen (Barcelona). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
14' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) will deliver the corner kick.
13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
11' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) latches onto a short pass from Lamine Yamal inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
4' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) does well to meet a cross inside the box and powers a header past the helpless goalkeeper.
3' 0 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Girona will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Hernandez.
